definitions.explanation: The team's main catcher, who plays the position most regularly. The prefix {正|せい} ("main; regular") contrasts with backup or rotating players.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はチームの{正捕手|せいほしゅ}だ。
examples.english: He is the team's starting catcher.

examples.japanese: ケガで{正捕手|せいほしゅ}の{座|ざ}を{失|うしな}った。
examples.english: He lost his starting catcher spot to an injury.

examples.japanese: {若手|わかて}が{今年|ことし}から{正捕手|せいほしゅ}として{起用|きよう}されている。
examples.english: A young player has been used as the starting catcher this year.

notes:
Compound of {正|せい} (main; regular) + {捕手|ほしゅ} (catcher). The {正|せい}- prefix attaches to position names to mark the player who normally starts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正捕手|せいほしゅ}の{座|ざ}: starting catcher position (literally "seat")
- {正捕手|せいほしゅ}に{抜擢|ばってき}される: to be picked as starting catcher
- {正捕手|せいほしゅ}{争|あらそ}い: competition for the starting catcher spot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {捕手|ほしゅ}: catcher (general)
- キャッチャー: catcher — more common loanword in spoken baseball talk
- {控|ひか}え{捕手|ほしゅ}: backup catcher
